title: Upcoming exhibition of Frederic Church's Maine studies
content: "Wood Interior Near Mount Katahdin," c. 1877, by Frederic Edwin Church (1826-1900), oil on paper mounted on canvas, 12 x 17 in.This painting will be one of 23 plein-air paintings and drawings exhibited at Olana in Hudson, New York. The show is called "Maine Sublime: Frederic Edwin Church's Landscapes of Mount Desert and Mount Katahdin." It opens June 9 and will continue through October.Outdoor PainterOlana websiteBook:Maine Sublime: Frederic Edwin Church's Landscapes of Mount Desert and Mount Katahdin
